tools.name: search_docs

tools.description: Fetch the full Markdown body of a specific docs page by its slug. Use this after `search_docs` when the user needs the complete content of a page. No authentication required.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Enumerate all available docs pages, optionally filtered by product (e.g. 'compass', 'legal', 'overview'). Use this to discover what slugs exist before calling `get_doc`. No authentication required.

tools.name: compass_pages_list
tools.description: Lists pages in the active workspace's Compass compendium. Optional `type` filter narrows to one node type (WORKFLOW, PERSON, SYSTEM, PAIN_POINT, DOCUMENT, VALUE, PRIORITY, AUDIENCE, OFFERING). tools.name: compass_pages_get
tools.description: Fetches one Compass page by id, including its full Markdown body, header fields, and any attached Napkin sketches — view an attached sketch's actual drawing with `napkin_boards_view` (its boardId) before discussing it.

tools.name: compass_statuses_list

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "compass" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, compass_opportunities_propose, compass_map_view, compass_interviews_list, compass_interviews_get, compass_inbox_list, compass_opportunities_set_status, comments_list, search_workspace · Private data: compass_pages_list, compass_pages_create, compass_links_create, compass_interview_targets, compass_gaps_create, compass_opportunities_propose, compass_opportunities_create, compass_opportunities_mark_implemented, compass_map_view, compass_opportunities_delete, search_workspace · Public sink: compass_pages_update, compass_interviews_create, compass_interview_targets · Destructive: compass_interviews_create, compass_pages_delete, compass_pages_restore, compass_links_update, compass_links_delete, compass_opportunities_delete, compass_changes_upsert, comments_create.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, compass_opportunities_propose, compass_map_view, compass_interviews_list, compass_interviews_get, compass_inbox_list, compass_opportunities_set_status, comments_list, search_workspace · Private data: compass_pages_list, compass_pages_create, compass_links_create, compass_interview_targets, compass_gaps_create, compass_opportunities_propose, compass_opportunities_create, compass_opportunities_mark_implemented, compass_map_view, compass_opportunities_delete, search_workspace · Public sink: compass_pages_update, compass_interviews_create, compass_interview_targets · Destructive: compass_interviews_create, compass_pages_delete, compass_pages_restore, compass_links_update, compass_links_delete, compass_opportunities_delete, compass_changes_upsert, comments_create

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
